# Supporting results: degree and subdivision sensitivity

90 configurations; 15 cache-off solves each (1350 total). All repeats agree on non-timing metrics. Runtime is minimum of 15 sequential executions of the Python optimization wrapper. Its elapsed_time includes the Rust solve AND subsequent Python validation and metric calculation; it is not isolated SCvx-loop time. Scenario trust radii: phase135/phase170 4000 km; others 2000 km.

Mean control acceleration is a reporting metric, not the minimized squared-acceleration objective. `J_true` evaluates the latter with nonlinear gravity using the verification harness quadrature. Certification requires aggregate hull violation <= 1e-6 km and stop reason 1 or 4. Stop 0 means iteration limit; stop 2 means trust-region collapse.

Raw repetitions: [raw.jsonl](raw.jsonl). Machine-readable summary: [results.csv](results.csv). Provenance: [metadata.json](metadata.json), [backend.json](backend.json). Run script: [rerun.py](rerun.py).

The manuscript originally reported only phase120 at 16 subdivisions. These results cover the full configured grid. Artifacts were produced before the wording-only commit 4efca35; the source commit and dirty state at run start are preserved in metadata.
